# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/super_events.mjs, docs/specs/06_events/06_super_events.md). Do not edit by hand.
# The super events of K52. Argument passing follows E1: a temporary variable zin_arg_<name> set just before the call.
#
# zin_super_event_<key>     any scope. Once per game (global flag zin_se_done_<key>): shows the super event to every human player in its audience
#                           (scripted trigger zin_se_audience_<name>, K61) and, where the moment has a report, sends the minor report event to the
#                           human players whose realm borders an audience realm without being in it. Called by the builder right after every
#                           place that sets the moment's hook flag (hookSuperEvents in modules/super_events.mjs). For the human players who
#                           see it, the super event replaces the news event of the same moment (K60): it sets zin_se_saw_<key>, which that
#                           news event's trigger reads, and runs zin_se_news_<event>, the news event's immediate block and first visible option.
# zin_se_news_<event>       country scope (a human player). Written by replaceNews over the finished tree: what the replaced news event would
#                           have done for this country.
# zin_super_event_open     country scope (a human player). Argument zin_arg_super_event: shows the id now, or queues it while another is open.
# zin_super_event_close     country scope. Closes the window and shows the next queued id, if any.
# zin_super_event_play      country scope. Plays the shown id's song for this player only (scoped_play_song), unless the player silenced the
#                           music of the great moments in the window (zin_se_music_off). The game's own music volume applies as to any song.
zin_super_event_golden_king_dead = {
	# 2: The Golden King Is Dead (B07; hook zin_golden_king_dead)
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_se_done_golden_king_dead } }
		set_global_flag = zin_se_done_golden_king_dead
		log = "ZIN super event 2 golden_king_dead"
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_se_audience_world = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_super_event = 2 }
			zin_super_event_open = yes
		}
	}
}

		set_global_flag = zin_se_done_without_the_heir
		log = "ZIN super event 32 without_the_heir"
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				zin_se_audience_war_of_the_living = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_super_event = 32 }
			zin_super_event_open = yes
			set_country_flag = zin_se_saw_without_the_heir
			zin_se_news_zin_eindil_140 = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_super_event_open = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_se_arg = zin_arg_super_event }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_se_open }
		add_to_array = { array = zin_se_queue value = zin_se_arg }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { zin_se_id = zin_se_arg }
		set_country_flag = zin_se_open
		zin_super_event_play = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { zin_se_dirty = 1 }
}
zin_super_event_close = {
	clr_country_flag = zin_se_open
	set_variable = { zin_se_id = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_queue^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_super_event = zin_se_queue^0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = zin_se_queue index = 0 }
		zin_super_event_open = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { zin_se_dirty = 1 }
}
zin_super_event_play = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_se_music_off } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 2 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_golden_king_dead"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 3 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_deliverer_crowned"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 4 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_heir_of_aen"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 5 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_last_crowns"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 6 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_western_crossing"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 7 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_black_north_marches"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 8 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_volgan_marches"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 9 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_name_of_the_deliverer"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 10 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_king_of_the_east"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 11 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_parim_taken"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 12 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_heir_returns"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 13 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_varner_falls"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 14 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_volgan_broken"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 15 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_kusven_forth"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 16 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_lorien_falls"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 17 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_afrit_dead"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 18 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_lost_cause"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 19 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_children_of_volgan"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 20 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_ashen_throne"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 21 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_golden_court"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 22 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_western_crown"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 23 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_strait_master"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 24 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_eastern_king"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 25 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_ending_unfinished"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 26 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_nafeher_falls"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 27 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_hall_of_horos"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 28 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_mirolon_falls"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 29 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_east_crosses_the_rift"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 30 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_black_compact"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 31 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_the_cliff"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_se_id = 32 } }
			scoped_play_song = "zin_se_without_the_heir"
		}
	}
}

zin_se_news_zin_eindil_90 = {
	# What zin_eindil.90 (events/zin_eindil.txt) does for a human player who sees super event 12 (heir_returns) instead (K60): its immediate block, then its first visible option.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_90_done }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_eindil_90_done
		if = {
			limit = {
				zin_eindil_has_host = yes
			}
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.91
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = ZOL
			}
			ZOL = {
				country_event = {
					id = zin_eindil.91
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
		zin_eindil_pick_host_candidate = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host_candidate
			}
			var:global.zin_eindil_host_candidate = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = yes
					}
					country_event = {
						id = zin_eindil.92
						days = 1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { zin_is_volgan = yes } NOT = { zin_is_zol = yes } }
		# this option changes nothing
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { zin_is_volgan = yes zin_is_zol = yes } }
		# this option changes nothing
	}
}
